title: Recursively change group ownership of a directory
summary: Use chgrp with the recursive flag to change the group ownership of a directory and all its contents.

steps.explain: Use the --recursive flag to apply the group change to the directory and everything inside it.

placeholders.name: GROUP
placeholders.description: The name of the group to assign

rollback.explain: Change the group back recursively to the original value.

warnings: This affects all files and subdirectories. Be careful not to change system directories unless you know what you are doing.
